You can help with the fight against childhood cancer!
100% of Little Adventures proceeds from the first 1000 Rapunzel Party Dresses by Jade sold will go to help Jade’s family with medical expenses. 

Jade is a brave 4-year-old who faced Rhabdomyosarcoma, a rare childhood cancer, with incredible courage and grace. After months of surgery, chemotherapy, and daily radiation across multiple states, she is now NED and shining brighter than ever. A true fashionista, Jade loves hot pink, butterflies, zebras, and strutting around in her favorite heels. Her playful spirit and the love of her siblings carried her through the toughest moments of her journey. Her custom dress, adorned with butterflies and small birds, celebrates her strength and honors a dear friend who soars beside her. This dress is a symbol of hope, courage, and the beautiful reminder that even after the hardest storms, joy and imagination always find their wings

Thank you for helping us to help Jade and other children fight this terrible disease!!

Help fight against childhood cancer!
100% of Little Adventures proceeds from 1000 Ice Twirl Dresses sold will go to help Emery's family. 

Emery, a typical four year old who loves dancing, reading, playing games, and watching movies. In September 2023, her life changed when her parents started noticing that things were a little off. Her skin tone was becoming more pale and she started having a little less energy. In just a couple weeks, she went from playing an entire soccer game to asking her coach to sit out before the game even started.

After some family members mentioned her color change, they decided she needed to see her doctor. They thought the doctor would say, “take this medicine and she will be back to normal.” Instead, they sent Emery to do a full set of blood work. Her mom called the doctor's office to get the results and was told that they needed to get her to Primary Children’s ER as soon as possible and that she needed a blood transfusion. They were completely shocked. 

In the hospital Emery received lab after lab, test after test. Two days later, the doctor said the dreaded words, “Your child has cancer.”  Those words shattered their world.  Emery was diagnosed with B-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia and the past year has been one big rollercoaster for them. Each phase of treatment comes with different side effects. Through it all, Emery has been such a champ! It has been the hardest year they’ve ever endured but she is doing her best to fight! Despite it all, she has remained #EmeryStrong! 

Thank you for helping us to help Emery and other children fight this terrible disease!! Buy Emery's dress today!

Features of the Alpine Princess Costume 

The best part of all Little Adventures costumes is that they are easy on, easy off. This allows your little ones to get dressed all by themselves, teaching them basic skills while having fun in the process.


It’s about time for children’s costumes that are not only easy to put on, but are itch-free, too. For some reason, many costumes seem to be composed of itchy material that sheds glitter. But like all of our other dresses, the Alpine Princess costume is glitter-, zipper-, and fuss-free. 


When your child feels comfortable, they won’t want the imaginative play to end, and they’ll be entertained for hours.


Some eye-catching elements of this princess dress include:


  • Stretchy velvet fabric that’s soft to the touch
  • Elegant design details such as floral prints at the button of the dress
  • Shiny, glittering appearance (without the mess)
  • High-quality material that will endure every adventure


Another great thing about this princess dress and other Little Adventure costumes is that they’re machine washable. We don’t think you should limit an adventure out of fear of getting a little dirty. We also don’t think you should have to send a costume to the dry cleaner each time you need it washed.


That’s why our costumes are machine washable, so your kids can get back to exploring in no time. 

Play Possibilities 

Once your child throws on the Alpine Princess costume, they’ll be ready to trek through any blizzard they encounter. 


There are many benefits to allowing your child to engage in imaginative play. When they put on a costume, such as the Alpine Princess costume, they get to experience the point of view and feelings of someone other than themselves and help build their emotional intellect.


In this gorgeous Alpine Princess dress, your little one can transform into the heroic Princess Svetlana, who courageously traveled across the Alps to rescue her parents, who were taken from the castle in the middle of the night. 


Or perhaps your child would prefer to be Princess Kirsten, who rules the kingdom with wisdom and kindness. Her subjects love her, and because of her grace and empathy, the land was prosperous and laughter filled the streets. 


The only limit is your child's imagination with this durable, soft, and adorable dress up!

Care Instructions

All Little Adventures’ products are made with parents in mind, and we know just how precious time can be. That’s why Little Adventures made it painless and easy to care for the dress up costumes your children adore. One of the benefits of the Alpine Princess costume by Little Adventures is that it’s entirely machine washable. 

Once your child’s dress has had its fair share of wear and could use a good cleaning, just throw it into a cold cycle in your washing machine. If you're the careful type, run the machine on delicate. Once it’s been washed, simply hang the costume up to air dry, and the dress will look good as new! 

Accessories for Your Alpine Princess Costume

To enhance your imaginative costume playtime, add some dazzling accessories! Little Adventures makes matching Alpine Princess doll dresses so that children can bring their favorite doll on their winter adventures in style.


Just like the Alpine Princess costume, the matching doll dress can be cleaned by simply tossing it into the washing machine for a quick rinse. No matter how daring the adventure your kiddo embarks on—like battling make-believe trolls in enchanted winter wonderlands—you can rest easy knowing most stains will come out, and they will be happy to have a dress that looks as good as new.


Don’t forget to check out our other princess accessories, so your little ones make the most of their imaginative playtime. With a wide variety of princess crowns in different colors, shapes, and sizes, there’s no doubt your child will fall in love with at least one! 

Let Your Kids Explore Their Creative Side With Little Adventures

The last thing that should be limited is a child’s imagination, and with Little Adventures, your children’s dress up options for imaginative playtime can be as expressive as their wildest dreams. From princesses to super heroes, your little one can embark on a new journey with a different cast of characters every day. Boredom will be a thing of the past when your kid can get in on the action they see in their favorite movies and books and make adventures of their own. 


Using only high-quality material that’s itch-free, Little Adventures creates dress ups that your child won’t ever want to take off! column3:
You can help with the fight against childhood cancer!
100% of Little Adventures proceeds from the first 1000 Princess Giovanna Dresses sold will go to help Giovanna’s family with ongoing testing and care. After the first 1000 dresses have sold, 15% will continue to support childhood cancer charities.

When Giovanna was eight and a half months old, her mother noticed that her belly was swollen and hard. She took her to the doctor for what she thought would be a routine visit. After an ultrasound was performed on little Giovanna, it was confirmed that she had a large tumor that filled her entire abdomen. Her parents would learn that she also had tumors in her liver. Bone marrow biopsies showed disease in her bones as well.

Giovanna was diagnosed with stage IV neuroblastoma. Her family was quickly directed to the amazing doctors at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center in New York. They were informed that the tumor would need to be removed with surgery. First however, they would need to try to shrink the tumor size with multiple rounds of chemotherapy. Tests would then determine the efficacy of the chemo The family waited anxiously for Giovanna’s scan results. It worked!
The tumor was 73% reduced! They would now need to allow her little body to recover enough to endure the dangerous surgery. In January 2017, Dr. LaQuaglia performed the life-saving surgery. After a 15 hour-long surgery, the main tumor was able to be completely removed. The tumors in her liver remain but are closely monitored. Giovanna has also had a birthmark on her arm that was found later and diagnosed as Mastocytosis. The many things that her body has been exposed to likely
caused a benign birthmark to develop into mastocytosis. The birthmark also is continually monitored.
This is where Little Adventures comes in, we want to help! Meet the Princess Giovanna dress. Giovanna designed this dress herself! She loves all the colors and so a rainbow color theme was chosen. She wanted it short enough that she could play in it. She also wanted it to twirl so that she could dance. We wanted it to have as much personality as she has…. so, we made it sparkle!
Giovanna’s bouncy red curls are a hint to her larger-than-life personality. Giovanna is spunky, happy and will light up the room with her sweet smile. She and her family continue to show the world that cancer will not define them. We have grown to love her and her family through this process and look to forward watching her live life to its fullest!! When you purchase you are helping Giovanna with her ongoing testing and care.
Thank you for helping us to help Giovanna and other children fight this terrible disease!!

Product Details

Our Rose Garden Fairy Wings are elegant yet durable, and the pink china silk lining looks delicate and sweet while the wireframe keeps things sturdy. In place of glitter, these sweet pink fairy wings have sparkling accents your kids will love!

 

Now you can also explore your child’s imagination without worrying about ruining a darling costume, thanks to the snag-free fabric used on the fun playtime accessory.  

 

Award-winning products like this dress up from Little Adventures come with a lifetime guarantee. Our dresses are soft and comfortable without itchy seams or underskirts and made so kids can take them off and slip them on all by themselves!

Benefits of Imaginative Play

Playing dress up is a great way to spend quality time with your kids. It shows them that it’s OK—and even fun—to dream big and be whoever they want to be. Dressing up gives your kiddos the ability to reach for the stars and express themselves without fear. Imaginative play also helps children think outside the box while simultaneously learning how to share their emotions and improve their communication skills. 


The Little Adventures Rose Garden Fairy Wings are the perfect accessory for any imaginative adventure. Made with high-quality materials that can withstand even the most daring of dress up playtimes, our pink fairy wings almost pay for themselves.


Now that kids seem to be spending more time in front of screens and less time engaging in imaginative play, dressing up provides opportunities for your little ones to explore different imaginary worlds without a rigid structure that puts a damper on their creativity. By adding a sparkly accessory into the mix, you can open doors to a variety of new worlds for your kids to play in. They might not realize it now, but they’ll remember what they learned to help them get through certain experiences later in life.

The Perfect Accessory for Any Costume

Our kids’ fairy wings make for a great addition to any costume collection. You don’t even need to have a fairy dress or skirt in your wardrobe. Your kids can always mix and match our Rose Garden Fairy Wings with just about anything for the ultimate dress up playtime adventure! Better yet, you can get some wings of your own that match our pink china silk accessory for double the fairy trouble—and fun! 


The Rose Garden Fairy Wings match perfectly with a jeweled slipper, a play tiara, and a magical fairy wand! 


Other great items to have nearby when playing dress up include paper and colored pencils. It can encourage your little ones to draw maps and more so they can let their imagination truly run wild. Dressing up could even stir up inspiration for new fashions in their heads. They can start planning out their next outfit with these tools while still dressed to impress in our pink fairy wings.

Making a Dress Up Box

A dress up box isn’t complete without accessories and props! Once you’ve started a small collection of costumes, add some extra flair to dress up time with some whimsical fairy wings, crowns or headbands, gloves, and more! By adding additional items into your dress up box, you’re also giving your children more pieces of clothing they can learn to put on. Plus, who hasn’t wanted to cast spells with a magic wand? These Rose Garden Fairy wings are the perfect addition to any dress up box!

Care Instructions

Keeping the Rose Garden Fairy wings looking sharp is simple and easy. Just wet a washcloth, add some dish soap, and spot-treat any stains you see. 


Our Rose Garden Fairy wings are easy to take on and off, making them the perfect accessory for kids of all ages. Every Little Adventures costume accessory is made out of high-quality materials so they can endure every journey on which your child embarks. These sweet fairy wings are sure to light your little one’s face up with joy and bring imaginative play to a whole new level. No-Hassle.

One day owner, Jenny Harrison, came across a post about a two year old girl named Hallie; a sassy, bouncy haired two year old battling cancer. After reading her story and learning more about her and her family, Hallie was chosen as the next Little Hero. Read on to find out more about her!

"One morning a lump was discovered in Hallies tummy. An ultrasound showed a large tumor. She was rushed to Primary Children’s hospital, where she was diagnosed with high risk, Stage 3 Neuroblastoma Cancer. After several rounds of intense chemotherapy, the tumor was removed along with her entire kidney. To ensure no cancer cells were left behind, she then endured a bone marrow transplant, radiation, and antibody therapy. This next phase in her cancer journey is very hopeful. We are amazed at her resilience through it all. She has a brave, magical soul, filled with joy and strength! Hallie is a true princess!"

-Hallie's Mom

To help Hallie and her family, Little Adventures will donate 100% of all proceeds for the first 1000 Princess Hallie dresses sold and after the first 1000 dresses have sold, 15% will be donated childhood cancer charities to help support kids currently undergoing cancer therapy. Thank you for you support!

column53:
More About This Product

This Cinderella dress isn’t just gorgeous; it is comfortable and perfect for playtime. We use gentle yet durable materials such as stretch velvet and china silk that won’t scratch or irritate your child’s delicate skin. These sweet dress-ups are award-winning products with a lifetime guarantee. They are soft and comfortable, with no itchy seams or underskirts, and are made for kids to take off and on all by themselves!

Mom Designed with Kids in Mind 

Two moms founded little Adventures with fifteen kids between the two of them. They worked to create comfortable, durable dress-ups that could keep up with their kids—and their imaginations. 

These dress-ups are beautiful and fun without any of the things that drive moms and kids crazy. That means:

  • No glitter that will get all over your house and furniture.
  • No more asking mom to button-up or zip-up the costumes.
  • No itchy, scratchy fabrics that kids won’t wear.
  • No poorly stitched seams and hems that come undone.

As a company founded by moms, we understand that keeping dress-ups clean can be a hassle. Poor-quality fabrics can shrink or fray in the washing machine, and most aren’t machine washable at all. But when you have a little prince or princess who wants to wear dress-ups day in and day out, those costumes can get really dirty, really fast.

All Little Adventures princess dresses are machine washable. Our quality fabrics won’t wear out even after multiple washes. That means nice, clean dress-ups for kids and no headache for moms. 

It’s not hard to see why moms and kids alike love Little Adventures dress-ups. Order some for your little ones today and watch their imaginations soar!

The Importance of Imaginary Play

Playing dress-up is more than just adorable; it’s important for your child’s development. As Pediatrics, the Official Journal of the American Academy of Pediatrics points out, “Play is not frivolous: it enhances brain structure and function and promotes executive function (i.e., the process of learning, rather than the content), which allows us to pursue goals and ignore distractions.” 

In other words, creating a safe and healthy space for our children to play allows them to learn, grow, and explore. As children tap into their imaginations, they can practice solving problems and processing emotions. 

There are numerous benefits to imaginary dress-up play. Here are just a few: 

  • Children can act out different behaviors in a safe environment.
  • Children can test new ideas.
  • Children can practice their social skills and language skills, especially when playing with adults or other children. 
  • Children practice problem solving during imaginative play.
  • Children can explore emotions and practice empathy, sympathy, and emotional resilience.

Giving your child time to play dress-up regularly is a great thing to do, especially since it will give them a well-needed break from screen-time. To encourage your children to engage in imaginary play: 

  • Provide supplies such as cardboard boxes and tubes that can be adapted to your child’s imagination.
  • Switch out dress-up items often so that children don’t become bored.
  • Play with them!

Playing Dress-Up with Your Child

Even more meaningful than playing alone is when children can play dress-up with an adult. Pediatrics also notes that “play supports the formation of the safe, stable, and nurturing relationships with all caregivers that children need to thrive.”

Though you might feel a little bit silly putting on a Cinderella dress, or a cape, or even a saddle (if you’ve been chosen as the royal steed), playing dress-up with your child will help you connect and deepen your familial bonds. 

When children can engage in imaginary play with adults in an environment where they feel safe, the positive experiences during play help to “regulate the body’s stress response.” In other words, playing dress-up with your child can help them to be mentally and emotionally healthier. 

When it comes to dress-up, nothing is more fun than having costumes that match. In addition to our children’s costumes, we sell adult-sized princess dresses (including a Cinderella dress), capes, cloaks, and accessories so that you can also become fully immersed in the game. 

The Little Adventures Difference 

We believe in children and the joy of imagination, and we want to be there for you and your family. We know you and your little ones will love our super comfy dress-ups, but if for any reason you are unsatisfied, items can be returned within 90 days of purchase for a refund or an exchange. 

Buy Little Adventures dress-ups for you and your family today!

Two of a Kind

Your sweet little one will enjoy playing dress up in their Bo Peep dress, but you can help them take playtime to the next level with the Bo Peep doll dress for their doll or stuffed animal friend. 


Made from the same lovely and soft materials, the Bo Peep doll dress is a miniature copy of our Bo Peep kids costume. Your child will be thrilled to match with their favorite toy. 


This matching doll dress employs a hook and loop closure to make it easy for small hands to fasten. No more frustration, just uninterrupted fun! 

More about This Product

Before you buy this Bo Peep outfit, we ask that you look at the sizing guide you’ll find near the top of the page. Sizes are meant to fit children ranging from ages 1-13 years. The skirt length will vary slightly based on how tall your child is and the size of the dress you buy but should fall between floor-length and tea-length. 


This Bo Peep dress is machine washable. We recommend you machine wash on cold, then allow the dress to hang dry. Please do not put this dress up in the dryer.

Mom-Designed with Kids in Mind 

After years of fighting with itchy, dry-clean-only dress ups, two moms founded our Little Adventures as a solution. Moms love us because we understand them, and we offer quality dress ups that don’t create more messes and headaches. Kids love us too, mostly because they love playing dress up for hours without being uncomfortable. 


Kids love: 

  • Being able to put on their dress ups all by themselves
  • Not getting scratched or poked by poor-quality dress ups
  • Bright colors and soft fabrics
  • Dress ups that can hold up during playtime


Moms love: 

  • No annoying glitter that gets everywhere (and has to be vacuumed up later) 
  • No dry clean only materials that are costly to care for
  • Happy kids engaging in imaginative play for hours

Ready for an Adventure

We have to warn you—these dress ups are so darn cute and comfortable that your child might want to wear them instead of regular outfits. They may want to wear them to bed, or school, or maybe even both!


At least you’ll have peace of mind knowing our dress ups are easy to clean and super durable. Plus, they have a lifetime guarantee. So if your little one wants to go to the grocery store dressed as Bo Peep, if you’re okay with it, so are we. 

The Power of Imagination 

As a parent, you want your child to grow up happy, healthy, and strong. Did you know that imaginative play just might be the answer to raising healthier and more emotionally resilient children? 


When kids engage in imaginative dress up play, they have a lot of fun, but they don’t realize how much they are learning and growing. Dress up play allows children a creative space to express and process emotion, act out scenarios, and even practice empathy. 


However, screen-time does not offer the same cognitive benefits to children. One landmark study suggests that children who spend a lot of time on screens have a harder time reading the emotions of others than children who do very little or no screen time. 


Your kids might not like it at first, but helping them make the switch from screen time to imaginative playtime can help them immensely in the long run. 

Little Adventures Loves Childhood

We love kids, and we love the magic of childhood. It makes us sad to see kids who have forgotten how to use their imaginations to play and explore but instead rely on technology or others to keep them entertained. 


We have created comfortable, hassle-free dress ups because we believe in the power of play, and we want children everywhere to experience the joy of imaginative play. We are honored when parents and guardians choose our products for their children. 


Thank you for letting us be a part of your little one’s childhood and allowing us the chance to help them connect with the magic inside them. We are confident our products will live up to your expectations, but if anything happens, we offer hassle-free returns and provide a lifetime guarantee on all of our dress ups. 


Bring Little Adventures dress ups into your home today!

More About This Product

What is the point of a dress up dress if it’s too itchy to put on? This lily pad princess dress is comfortable enough to wear all day without compromising on style. The skirt length should fall somewhere around long tea-length to floor-length, based on your child’s height and the size you choose. Refer to our sizing guide above to get the perfect fit for your little one. 


This sweet little dress is an award-winning product with a lifetime guarantee.  It is soft and comfortable, with no itchy seams or underskirts, and is made for kids to take off and on all by themselves! 

Mom Designed with Kids in Mind 

Little Adventures was founded by two moms who happen to have 15 kids between the two of them! They put their mom knowledge to good use when designing these specially made dress ups and created comfortable, durable dress ups that could keep up with their kids and their active imaginations.


As much as you want to encourage your child to play dress up, you don’t want to spend your whole day zipping and unzipping or buttoning and unbuttoning their favorite dress. So, we made our dress ups soft and stretchy and easy to put on, enabling your child to do it without you. 


And, while you want to encourage your little fashionista, you don’t want to be vacuuming up glitter for the next three months. That’s why all of our dress ups are glitter-free but still pretty enough to please even the pickiest prima donna. 


Best of all, you no longer have to wipe away tears when that chocolate-milk-stained dress comes out of the wash three sizes too small because it was dry-clean only (and you forgot to read the tag!). All of our dresses, including the lily pad princess dress, are machine washable. Simply wash and hang to dry. 

The Benefits of Dress Up

When your children play dress up, they aren’t just having fun. Dress up play is actually important for children developmentally. Through dress up, children can practice social skills, test behaviors, act out scenarios that enable them to problem solve and develop emotional resilience. 


In short, dress up play helps your child to develop cognitively. By providing your children a safe environment to play imaginatively, you give them the space to grow. But don’t just take our word for it. Early childhood educator, Sarah Baldwin, discusses dress up and lists multiple benefits for children, including:


  • Engaging your child’s brain and memory
  • Giving your child the chance to practice linguistic skills and expand their vocabulary
  • Practice empathy and understand it more deeply
  • Explore gender roles 
  • Exercise their imaginations


It’s a good idea to encourage your children to participate in regular imaginative play, such as dress up play. Not only do they get to enjoy being immersed in a world of play, but they also are able to take a natural break from regular day-to-day routines. 


Giving your child time to embrace their inner lily pad princess and play dress up regularly is a great thing to do, especially since it will give them a well-needed break from screen time. While screen time isn’t bad, too much of it can impact your child’s growth and health. 


For example, the results from an eye-opening study found that “sixth-graders who went five days without even glancing at a smartphone, television, or other digital screen did substantially better at reading human emotions than sixth-graders from the same school who continued to spend hours each day looking at their electronic devices.”


The results were clear: kids who took breaks from screen time were more socially in-tune than their peers. Dress up play is a great way to avoid excess screen time in your routine. Kids will be having so much fun they’ll forget the tablet altogether. 


Help your kids love dress up play with Little Adventures dress ups! 

Little Adventures in Your Home

Life is busy and time passes quickly. Your little one’s childhood is a time to nurture and appreciate. Help your children develop the gift of imagination with dress ups that are as resilient as they are. 


Little Adventures is loved by parents and children all over, and we are honored to have our products in so many homes and playrooms. While we are confident that our dress ups can handle whatever your kids throw at them, be rest assured that if a dress up doesn’t hold up, we’ll replace it right away with our lifetime guarantee policy. 


Bring Little Adventures into your home today with our comfy, machine-washable dress ups.

When Ava was 3 years-old, she developed a limp in her right leg. After an emergency MRI that day, a biopsy of her leg, and an eventual discovery of her primary kidney tumor, her family was told that she had stage IV high-risk neuroblastoma that had spread to her pelvis, right leg, spinal column, skull and midsection. Ava has had 6 rounds of chemo, 9 surgeries, a bone marrow transplant, radiation and 5 rounds of antibody therapy. For 15 months, Ava had no evidence of disease, until she had a relapse in her skull. She needed extensive specialized treatment. She is currently enrolled in the Bivalent Vaccine clinical trial to hopefully keep her disease-free. She is sweet, loves dress ups, and her friends. Ava is one of the most courageous young women that we know, she has fought this terrible disease with such bravery and grace. She is our LITTLE HERO!!! Ava hopes that by designing this dress she can help other kids like her find courage to fight this terrible disease.

We are so glad that both parents and kids love our products. We know a thing or two about dress ups. Little Adventures was founded by moms, after all!

Replace Screen Time With Imaginative Play

It’s no surprise that parents and caregivers have become concerned about their children’s screen time. While some screen time can be beneficial for children, especially when it is educational, too much can be detrimental. 


The Mayo Clinic reports that the “average time spent on screens is seven to 10 hours” per day. That’s nearly ⅓ of a day—more than half of a child’s waking hours—spent on a screen. It is absolutely too much. 


The American Academy of Pediatrics recommends no screen time for children under age two, one hour per day of screen time for ages 12 and under, and only two hours per day of screen time for teenagers and adults. 


While you will probably have to change your lifestyle to get your child’s screen time under these limits, the benefits to your child’s health are worth the effort. 


One easy alternative is to replace screen time with imaginative dress up play. dress up play is appropriate for children within a wide age range, is extremely affordable, and requires little or no planning beforehand. 

Benefits of Dress Up Play

Perhaps the best part of replacing screen-time with dress up play is the fact that dress up play comes with so many benefits for children. 


According to Sarah Baldwin, some of those benefits include: 

  • Helping children to develop emotionally by giving them a safe space to process feelings and fears in a safe environment. 
  • Helping them to develop fine motor skills by putting on and taking off costumes
  • Allowing kids to imitate behaviors and roles that they have seen in real life
  • Giving kids an opportunity to exercise their imaginations and improve their creative thinking skills.  


It’s time to swap the screens for play that’s not only fun but also helps your children to grow. Encourage your child to play dress up by designating screen-free times of the day. Then bring out the costumes, such as our Sleeping Beauty dress. Engage your children’s imaginations with raw materials like paper, cardboard tubes, and boxes so they can create their own sets and props.

We believe that playing dress up is wholesome fun that helps kids explore the world around them. It’s a magical part of childhood that parents should foster and appreciate. Our dream is to provide quality dress ups for your family that your children will want to play with again and again.

Made to Match

Our Sleeping Beauty doll dress is wonderful on its own, but it is even better to complement our Sleeping Beauty dress up dress for children. The doll dress is a miniature version of the dress up, crafted with a commitment to quality and comfort. 


Both the Sleeping Beauty dress up and the doll dress are made from the same fabric and materials. Your little one will adore how well their costume matches with their doll or plush animal. 


Whether you buy both dresses as a set or buy the doll dress later as a gift, your child will love these products. It’s the perfect birthday present, Christmas present, or surprise gift before or after visiting a fairy-tale-themed theme park. 

Mom Designed With Kids In Mind 

As a company founded by moms, we understand how important it is for children to play dress up and play with dolls. We also know that dress ups and doll clothes are too often poorly designed. 


That’s why we have eliminated everything moms hate about doll clothes: 

  • No poor quality fabrics
  • No glitter 
  • No dry-clean only
  • No tricky zippers or buttons


Now, your children can play dolly dress up for hours, and you can relax. If your child spills chocolate milk on their doll’s Sleeping Beauty doll dress or gets it soaked in mud, you can simply throw it in the wash. In no time at all, your little ones will be back to playing happily.


Is Playing With Dolls Good For Children? 

If you have a little prince or princess, you probably have a box full of dolls and stuffed animals. But are those toys just taking up space? Parents may wonder if playing with dolls is truly helpful for their children. 


Good news: doll play is great for kids and can lead to developmental growth!


In a study on the effects of doll play on children, conducted by Gerson et al. at Cardiff University, researchers found that “doll play activates brain regions which are associated with social information processing and empathy, indicating that doll play enables children to rehearse, use and perform these skills even when playing on their own.”


In other words, through doll play, children can practice using empathy and compassion. They can improve their social skills by acting out scenarios, even when engaging in solo doll play. 


This study is groundbreaking because it supplies neurological evidence to support Jean Piaget’s theories that play is beneficial for children. 


Doll play is also great for modern kids and families because it provides a natural break from screen time. By encouraging your children to engage in doll play, you help them practice using their imaginations, becoming less reliant on tablets and smartphones for entertainment. 

Is Doll Play Beneficial For All Children? 

Societally, we have been conditioned to see doll play as something for young girls, but both boys and girls can enjoy and benefit from doll play. Gerson et al. reported that the “benefits of solo doll play were shown to be equal for both boys and girls.” 


Both boys and girls develop neurologically when they engage in doll play. As a parent, you don’t need to worry about your child engaging in doll play if it doesn’t quite fit into gender norms. Your child, regardless of gender, can learn and develop their social skills when allowed to play with dolls. 


Indeed, allowing your boys to play with dolls may be highly beneficial to them. In an article about toy play, Kevin Zoromski pointed out that “all play leads to higher achievement in developmental milestones for children who are given the choice of how to play and what to play with.” So go ahead and let your little ones play how they like. 

Bring Little Adventures Home

Little Adventures is all about fostering and encouraging a child’s imagination and creativity without creating a hassle for mom. Our high-quality, glitter-free, machine washable dress ups and doll clothes, including our Sleeping Beauty doll dress, are made to last whatever adventures your child goes on.


Little Adventures products will get your children excited about imaginary play and help them take needed breaks from screen time. Nurture your little ones and their growing minds by giving them time to play and create.

Your little one will be tickled with delight when they discover that their doll’s dress up matches their own. And we really mean matches because the yellow doll dress and the Yellow Beauty dress are made from the exact same materials. 


The Yellow Beauty dress is a gorgeous dress up that features a yellow china silk skirt and printed organza overlay. This dress will shine and catch the light but has no annoying glitter to cause messes. It even captures the little details, such as small roses on the bodice and skirt. 

More about This Doll Dress

This product is meant to fit a variety of dolls and animals ranging from 16" to 20". However, we can’t guarantee it will fit all toys. Feel free to contact us for more information about our doll clothes. 


Like our dress ups, our doll dresses are machine washable. Machine wash cold, then hang dry. Do not dry them in the dryer or dry clean. 

Mom-Designed with Kids in Mind 

We hate itchy, scratchy dress ups just as much as your kids do. That’s why Little Adventures is committed to creating the best possible dress ups that don’t create headaches later. We were founded by moms, after all! 


Kids love that they can play dress up all day and feel comfortable. Our brightly colored costumes are so cute, your child will feel like they’re stepping into a fairy tale. 


Moms love us too because we make life easier. Looking for a lovely princess dress for your little one? We offer many different styles, and they’re all glitter-free! Dress up got messy during playtime? Just throw it in the wash! Best of all, if your dress ups don’t hold up to the wear and tear of imaginative play, we’ll replace it with our lifetime guarantee. 


Take Me Anywhere

Our doll dresses may be beautiful, but they’re not flimsy. That means your child can take their doll or stuffed animal in their costume on any adventure they go on. That includes the library, the car, the airport, the hospital, and sleepovers. 


If your little one wants the support and comfort of their doll, go ahead and let them bring it along. We’re confident our durable doll clothes will hold up, but if something happens, you can always rely on our lifetime guarantee. We’re ready for an adventure! 

Getting Back to Playtime

More and more, it seems traditional playtime is being replaced by screen time. But kids still need imaginative play as much as before. 


When we see kids today playing all day on tablets and smartphones, it’s so common it almost seems normal. But did you know that the American Academy of Pediatrics suggests kids age 12 and younger should have only one hour of screen time per day? One hour! For many families, that would require some drastic changes. 


Luckily, dress up play is an easy and much healthier alternative. With the right costumes, it’s not hard to get your little ones to start using their imaginations. They’ll be so excited they’ll forget about watching TV for a few hours. 


Unlike screen time, when kids play dress up for playtime, they receive many cognitive benefits. Here are just a couple: 

  • Improved emotional resilience
  • Development of empathy
  • Improved verbalization and communication skills


Give your child the gift of play by encouraging them to use their imaginations with dress up. 

Have Your Own Little Adventures

Your kids grow up so fast. Help them have the richest, most meaningful childhood possible by letting them learn to love playtime and use their imaginations.

From all of us at Little Adventures, here’s to childhood playtime in all of its forms!

Playtime isn’t just something fun for your child to do. Playing dress up helps children explore their creative side and also learn how to do little yet important things that are part of everyday life. This includes learning how to get dressed, working on finding their voice, and sharing their emotions. 


This Sleeping Beauty Day Dress is easy to take on and off, making it a great starting point when teaching your kids how to dress independently. Because this costume is easy to put on and take off, it means less time that you have to spend dressing them and more time playing with them and enjoying their company. 

Joining in on Dress Up Play

Dressing up isn’t just something your child can do. You can encourage dress up play by finding a costume of your own to join in on the fun. By showing your kids that it’s OK to get lost in their imagination, they may feel more comfortable engaging in this type of interactive play.


You can even invite some friends over to jump into the magical land you’ve created. Who knows, maybe they’ll even show up in a Sleeping Beauty dress, too! When it comes to dressing up, having two of the same costume doesn’t have to mean competition. It actually allows little ones to practice communicating and sharing while igniting their imaginations with different storylines for their Sleeping Beauty characters—and how they can work together. They can spend hours engaging and interacting in imaginative play while learning how to process their emotions at the same time, too.


To add to the fun, Little Adventures also makes a matching Sleeping Beauty Day Dress and headband for dolls, so your child can take her favorite toy on any magical journey she chooses. Whether your little one prefers playing with friends, dolls, or both, her day will be filled with excitement and fun no matter what adventures take place.

A Dress Made For Every Day Play

We all know that a full day of non-stop play isn’t as realistic as our little princesses would hope. There are errands to run and chores to do; however, the fun doesn’t have to stop when you leave the house. Little Adventures dress ups are made for everyday play. Your child can wear them anywhere! 


Leave your worries behind about your kids' dress ups getting dirty when they leave the house. Don’t break a sweat if your little one wants to help in the kitchen while wearing the Sleeping Beauty day dress. All our dresses are glitter-free, soft, non-irritating, and absolutely machine washable. We believe in quality dresses made for everyday play!


Those are the magic words, aren’t they? “Machine washable.” It’s great for kids but even better for parents! We believe in the best of both worlds. Whether they’re creating cupcakes or mud cakes, you can rest assured that this dress was made for serious playtime.

Care Instructions

The best part about our Sleeping Beauty dress is that it’s easy to clean! Kids aren’t known to be the cleanest around, and knowing that all it takes to make this dress like new is a quick toss in the washing machine is a major win. 


To wash the dress, all you have to do is set the washing machine to normal or select a delicate cycle if you want to be extra careful. Be sure to use cold water to eliminate any possible shrinking that could occur. Rather than machine-drying the dress, just hang it up to air dry. 


Our costumes are made to last, and if you handle them with care when washing, you can ensure the dress will be in peak condition for your little Sleeping Beauty. 


If you want to give your child a costume they’ll love and want to play in for hours, then the Sleeping Beauty Day Dress is perfect for you!

In addition, no tricky buttons or zippers will get caught in the fabric. Like all our dress ups, simple is best with our Little Adventures Beauty Day Dress. 

Comfort. Kids enjoy wearing these dress ups for hours without complaint. Too often children’s costumes are made with cheap glitter and scratchy tulle. Children often complain about rough seams and edges irritating their skin. Our inside seams are carefully wrapped to reduce rashes and discomfort.  When you see sparkles in a Little Adventures design, rest assured they are safe. We use a non-shedding glitter that stays where it belongs. Additionally, we only use soft fabrics to create dress ups for kids. 

Washability. The Little Adventures Beauty Day Dress is machine-washable. This makes cleaning easy for mom and dad. Let your kids be kids without worrying about inside or outside play, rain or shine. No matter how messy they get, cleanup is simple. Just machine-wash the dress in cold water or gentle cycle. After hanging it to dry for a few hours, that dress is good as new and ready for tomorrow’s playtime. 

Versatility. Our dress ups come in a wide variety of sizes for children ages one to thirteen years. We make Little Adventures dress ups with a soft, stretchy fabric that will easily fit growing bodies. For guidance with sizes or styles, check out this easy-to-use sizing guide to choose the perfect fit for your little one. 

Hassle-free returns. If your recent purchase hasn’t been worn, with tags still attached, return it at no additional cost. And no worries — try-ons are okay! Learn more about our convenient return policy here. 

The Benefits of Play

Imaginative play benefits your children in a variety of ways. When kids make believe, they improve both verbal and non-verbal communication skills. This allows them to better interact with others. They also begin to think more creatively and improve problem-solving abilities. When other children join in the fun, peer-to-peer interaction encourages cooperation and team-building skills. They learn to tell more complicated stories and improve upon their own self-confidence. Dress ups and costumes also create memories that last a lifetime. 

Dressing up also gets kids to trade screen time for unstructured playtime. This is important for growing brains and bodies. Staying active and unplugged for at least an hour every day helps them burn energy, sleep better at night and do better in school.
